Baked Chicken In Beer
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, February 22, 2010 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




2 whole chicken breasts, cut into pieces
5 tablespoons flour mixed with salt
pepper, onion powder, 2 cans cream of chicken soup
3 tablespoons soy sauce
1/2 can beer

Preparation

1 Coat chicken with flour, salt and pepper. Then place in casserole. Blend together soup, soy sauce, beer and pour over chicken. Bake at 350 degrees uncovered for 45 minutes.  serve over white rice.
